If a person sells or rents a product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark or imports, displays or stores such products for the purpose of selling or renting the product, in violation of Article 26 (1);

If a person acts as a sales broker or import agent for a product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (2);
If a person uses a product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (3).

In any of the following cases, a Mayor/ Do Governor may order any manufacturer, importer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker or import agent of consumer products subject to compliance with safety standards to suspend sales of any consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards or to take other required measures for a specified period, as prescribed by Presidential Decree:

If any consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards does not meet the safety standards under Article 28 (referring to the standards under the proviso of the that Article, if the standards are applicable);
If a person fails to put the mark specified in Article 29 (1) or fraudulently puts such mark;
If a person modifies or removes the mark of a consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards, in violation of Article 29 (2);

If a person sells any consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards without the mark specified in Article 29 (1), or imports, displays or stores such consumer product, in violation of Article 30 .

In any of the following cases, a Mayor/ Do Governor may order any manufacturer, importer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker, buying agent, or import agent of consumer products subject to child protective packaging to suspend sales of any consumer product subject to child protective packaging to take other required measures for a specified period, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
If any consumer product subject to child protective packaging is not packaged with child protective packaging materials, in violation of Article 32 (1);
If a person fails to file a report or a report on change in accordance with Article 32 (2);
If a person produces or imports any consumer product subject to child protective packaging not conforming to the safety standards under Article 32 (4);
If a person fails to put the mark of child protective packaging, in violation of Article 33 (1);
If a person uses the mark of child protective packaging or any similar mark or label, in violation of Article 33 (2);

If a person sells any consumer product subject to child protective packaging without the mark of child protective packaging or imports, displays or stores such product for the purpose of selling the product in violation of Article 34 .

In any of the following cases, a Mayor/ Do Governor may order any manufacturer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker, etc. of electrical appliances subject to safety inspection to suspend the sale of any electrical appliances subject to safety inspection or to take other required measures, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: <Added on Oct. 18, 2022>
If an electrical appliances subject to safety inspection fails to undergo safety inspections, in violation of Article 34-3 (1);

If an electrical appliances subject to safety inspection fails to meet the safety standards prescribed in the main clause of Article 34-3 (2) (referring to the standards prescribed by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy, where a safety inspection is conducted under the proviso of that paragraph);
If a person fails to put a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-4 (1);
If a person puts a safety inspection mark, etc. or a similar mark, in violation of Article 34-4 (2);
If a person modifies or removes a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-4 (3);

If a person sells or rents electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc. or displays or stores such appliances for the purpose of selling or renting them, in violation of Article 34-5 (1);
If a person engages in sales brokerage of electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-5 (2);
If a person uses electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-5 (3);

If a person who is issued an order to suspend the sales of electrical appliances or take other required measures, or any other similar order under this Act or other statutes produces such appliances as electrical appliances subject to safety inspection to sell or rent them.

If any manufacturer, importer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker, buying agent, or import agent of products subject to safety control fails to comply with an order issued to suspend sales or to take other required measures under paragraphs (1) through (6), the relevant Mayor/ Do Governor may authorize public officials of the City/ Do to destroy or recall the relevant products subject to safety control, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. Expenses incurred in such cases shall be borne by the relevant manufacturer, importer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker, buying agent or import agent of products subject to safety control. <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>

Public officials who destroy or recall products subject to safety control under paragraph (7) shall carry a certificate indicating their authority and present it to relevant persons. <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>

If a Mayor/ Do Governor deems it impracticable to prevent hazards caused by products subject to safety control only by suspending sales of such products or taking other measures under paragraphs (1) through (7), he or she may order the relevant manufacturer, importer, distributor, rental business operator, commercial user, sales broker, buying agent, or import agent of such products to perform the following actions, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
Public disclosure of the fact that the person has been ordered to suspend sales or to take other measures;
Exchange, refund or repair of the relevant product subject to safety control;
Other measures that the Mayor/ Do Governor deems necessary for preventing hazards.
Article 41 (Reporting and Inspection)

If the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy or a Mayor/ Do Governor deems necessary for safety control of products, he or she may require any of the following persons to submit a report on the production, importation, distribution, rental, use, etc. of the relevant products or may authorize public officials of the Ministry or City/ Do to enter any office, factory, place of business, store, warehouse, or other necessary places to inspect manufacturing facilities, inspection facilities, products, documents, books of accounts, and other articles, or ask questions to interested persons:
A manufacturer, an importer or an import agent of products subject to safety control;
A distributor, a sales broker or a buying agent of products subject to safety control;
A rental business operator of products subject to safety control;
A person who produces products by using products subject to safety control as components or parts;
Any of the following persons who use electrical appliances subject to safety control:
An electric utility business operator defined in subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Electric Utility Act ;
A person who builds electric installations for private use as defined in subparagraph 19 of Article 2 of the Electric Utility Act ;
A constructor defined in subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Electrical Construction Business Act ;
A person who uses consumer products subject to safety control for commercial purposes.

When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy or a Mayor/ Do Governor intends to conduct an inspection under paragraph (1) (including an inquiry; hereafter in this Article, the same shall apply), he or she shall inform interested persons of the inspection plan, which shall include the following matters, by no later than seven days before the date of inspection: Provided , That the foregoing shall not apply to emergent cases or cases where it is deemed impracticable to attain the purpose of inspection, if prior notice is given, due to probable destruction of evidence, etc.:
Date and time of the inspection;
Reasons for the inspection;
Details of the inspection.

Public officials who intend to enter a place to conduct an inspection under paragraph (1) shall carry a certificate indicating their authority and produce the certificate to interested persons; and public officials who enter an office or any other place shall present a document stating the following matters to interested persons:
Names of the public officials;
Time of entry;
Purposes of entry.
Article 42 (Request to Provide Information)
Matters concerning the suspension of sales, etc. under Article 40 (1) through (7);
Matters concerning the reporting, inspection, and inquiry under Article 41 ;
Matters concerning the imposition of administrative fines under Article 51 .
Article 43 (Fees)
Any of the following persons shall pay fees, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who wishes to be designated as a safety certification body under Article 4 (1);
A person who wishes to obtain a safety certification under Article 5 (1);
A person who wishes to obtain a revised certification under Article 5 (2);
A person who wishes to be fully or partially exempted from safety certification under subparagraph 1 of Article 6 ;
A person who intends to undergo a periodic inspection for products subject to safety certification under Article 7 (1);
A person who intends to undergo a safety inspection for electrical appliances subject to safety certification under Article 8 (1);
A person who wishes to be designated as a testing lab for safety verification under Article 14 (1);
A person who intends to undergo a test for safety verification or file a safety verification report under Article 15 (1);
A person who intends to file a report on change in safety verification under Article 15 (2);
A person who wishes to obtain confirmation on full or partial exemption from the duty to file a safety verification report under subparagraph 1 of Article 16 ;
A person who intends to undergo a safety inspection for electrical appliances subject to safety verification under Article 17 (1);
A person who intends to file a report or a report on change in the supplier's declaration of conformity under Article 23 (2);

A person who wishes to obtain confirmation on exemption from the supplier's duty of declaration of conformity or from the supplier's duty to file a report on the declaration of conformity under subparagraph 1 of Article 24 ;
A person who intends to file a report or a report on change in consumer products subject to child protective packaging under Article 32 (2);
A person who intends to obtain designation of a safety inspection institution under Article 34-2 (1);
A person who intends to have electrical appliances subject to safety inspection undergo safety inspections under Article 34-3 (1).
Any of the following persons shall pay fees, as prescribed by municipal ordinance of the relevant City/ Do within the limits specified by Presidential Decree:
A person who wishes to obtain confirmation on full or partial exemption from safety certification under subparagraph 2 of Article 6 ;
A person who wishes to obtain confirmation on full or partial exemption from the duty to file a safety verification report under subparagraph 2 of Article 16 ;

A person who wishes to obtain confirmation on exemption from the supplier's duty of declaration of conformity or from the supplier's duty to report on the declaration of conformity under subparagraph 2 of Article 24 .
Article 44 (Hearings)
Revocation of the designation of a safety certification body or the suspension of business operations of a safety certification body under Article 12 (1);
Revocation of the designation of a testing lab for safety verification or the suspension of business operations of a testing lab for safety verification under Article 21 (1);
Revocation of the designation of a safety inspection institution or the suspension of business operations of a safety inspection institution under Article 34-6 (1).
Article 45 (Delegation and Entrustment of Authority)

The authority of the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy under this Act may be partially delegated to each Mayor/ Do Governor or the head of an agency affiliated with the Ministry, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

The administrative affairs assigned to the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy under this Act may be partially entrusted to the head of an institution or organization engaged in any business related to safety control of products, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

A Mayor/ Do Governor may partially re-delegate the authority delegated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy under paragraph (1) to the head of a Si / Gun / Gu (Gu means an autonomous Gu) with approval by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy.
When a Mayor/ Do Governor re-delegates the authority under paragraph (3), he or she shall publicly notify the re-delegation.
Article 46 (Incorporation of Results of Assessment of Hazards)
Article 47 (Safety Control of Raw Materials for Products subject to Safety Control)
Surveys, analyses and research necessary for safety control of raw materials, including the examination of hazards of raw materials;
Guidance, supervision and assistance to manufacturers, importers, etc. of raw materials or products subject to safety control;
Other measures prescribed by Presidential Decree for safety control of raw materials.
Article 48 (Legal Fiction as Public Officials for Purposes of Applying Penalty Provisions)
Members who are not public officials, among members of the Committee;
Executive officers and employees engaged in safety certification in a safety certification body;
Executive officers and employees engaged in testing for safety verification in a testing lab for safety verification;
Executive officers and employees engaged in safety inspections in a safety inspection institution;
Executive officers and employees of an institution or organization performing administrative affairs entrusted under Article 45 (2).
Article 49 (Penalty Provisions)
Any of the following persons shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than three years or by a fine not exceeding 30 million won: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who has been designated as a safety certification body by fraud or other improper means and conducts safety certifications or safety inspections;
A person who conducts safety certifications or safety inspections without being designated as a safety certification body;
A person who obtains a safety certification under Article 5 (1) by fraud or other improper means;
A person who produces or imports a product subject to safety certification without obtaining a safety certification, in violation of Article 5 (1);
A person who has not obtained a revised certification, in violation of the main clause of Article 5 (2);
A person who issues a safety certification, in violation of safety standards or standards for factory assessment under Article 5 (3);
A person who has undergone a safety inspection under Article 8 (1) by fraud or other improper means;
A person who imports used electrical appliances subject to safety certification without undergoing a safety inspection, in violation of Article 8 (1);
A person who conducts a safety inspection, in violation of standards for safety inspection under Article 8 (2);
A person who puts the safety certification mark or any similar mark or label, in violation of Article 9 (2);

A person who sells or rents any electrical appliance subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark, or imports, displays, or stores such electrical appliances for the purpose of selling or renting such electrical appliance, in violation of Article 10 (1);

A person who acts as a sales broker, a buying agent or an import agent for electrical appliances subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 10 (2) (excluding a person who acts as a buying agent under subparagraph 1 of Article 35) ;

A person who continues safety certifications or safety inspections after the person has the designation as a safety certification body revoked or during the period of suspension of business operations under Article 12 (1);
A person who has been designated as a testing lab for safety verification by fraud or other improper means and conducts tests for safety verification or safety inspections;
A person who conducts tests for safety verification or safety inspections without being designated as a testing lab for safety verification;
A person who files a safety verification report by fraud or other improper means;
A person who produces or imports products subject to safety verification without filing a safety verification report, in violation of Article 15 (1);
A person who has not filed a report on change in safety verification, in violation of the main clause of Article 15 (2);
A person who conducts a test for safety verification, in violation of safety standards under Article 15 (4);
A person who undergoes a safety inspection under Article 17 (1) by fraud or other improper means;
A person who imports any used electrical appliance subject to safety verification without undergoing a safety inspection, in violation of Article 17 (1);
A person who conducts a safety inspection, in violation of standards for safety inspection under Article 17 (2);
A person who puts the safety verification mark or any similar mark or label, in violation of Article 18 (2);

A person who sells or rents any electrical appliance subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark or imports, displays or stores such electrical appliance for the purpose of selling or renting the electrical appliance, in violation of Article 19 (1);

A person who acts as a sales broker, a buying agent or an import agent for electrical appliances subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 19 (2) excluding a person who acts as a buying agent under subparagraph 2 of Article 35) ;

A person who continues tests for safety verification after the person has the designation as a testing lab for safety verification revoked, or during the period of suspension of business operations under Article 21 (1);
A person who makes the supplier's declaration of conformity by fraud or other improper means;
A person who produces or imports products subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without making the supplier's declaration of conformity, in violation of Article 23 (1);
A person who puts the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity, etc., or label, in violation of Article 25 (2);

A person who sells or rents any electrical appliance subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark or imports, displays or stores such electrical appliance for the purpose of selling or renting the electrical appliance, in violation of Article 26 (1);

A person who acts as a sales broker or an import agent for electrical appliances subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (2);
A person who puts the mark of child protective packaging or any similar mark or label, in violation of Article 33 (2);
A person who has been designated as a safety inspection institution by fraud or other improper means and conducts safety inspections;
A person who conducts safety inspections without being designated as a safety inspection institution;
A person who has electrical appliances subject to safety inspection undergo safety inspections under Article 34-3 (1) by fraud or other improper means;
A person who produces electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without having such appliances undergo a safety inspection, in violation of Article 34-3 (1);

A person who fails to comply with the safety standards prescribed in the main clause of Article 34-3 (2) (referring the standards prescribed by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy, where a safety inspection is conducted under the proviso of that paragraph) when conducting safety inspections;
A person who puts a safety inspection mark, etc. or a similar mark, in violation of Article 34-4 (2);

A person who sells or rents electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc. or displays or stores such appliances for the purpose of selling or renting them, in violation of Article 34-5 (1);
A person who engages in sales brokerage of electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-5 (2);

A person who conducts safety inspections following revocation of the designation of a safety inspection institution under Article 34-6 (1) or during the period of suspension of business operations under that paragraph;
A person who acts as a buying agent, in violation of an order issued to forbid the person from providing buying services under Article 37 (1);
A person who fails to comply with an order issued under any paragraph of Article 40 (1) through (6) or (9).
Any of the following persons shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than two years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who modifies or removes the safety certification mark or a similar mark, without permission, in violation of Article 9 (3);
A person who modifies or removes the safety verification mark or a similar mark, without permission, in violation of Article 18 (3);
A person who modifies or removes the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, without permission, in violation of Article 25 (3);
A person who modifies or removes a safety inspection mark, etc. without permission without good reason, in violation of Article 34-4 (3).
Any of the following persons shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than one year or by a fine not exceeding 10 million won: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who is exempted from safety certification under Article 6 by fraud or other improper means;
A person who uses an electrical appliance subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 10 (3);
A person who issues a safety certification, in violation of Article 11 (3);
A person who is exempted from the duty to file a safety verification report under Article 16 by fraud or other improper means;
A person who uses an electrical appliance subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 19 (3);
A person who is exempted from the supplier's duty of declaration of conformity or the supplier's duty to report on the declaration of conformity under Article 24 by fraud or other improper means;

A person who uses an electrical appliance subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (3);
A person who fails to use child protective packaging materials for consumer products subject to child protective packaging, in violation of Article 32 (1);

A person who sells consumer products subject to child protective packaging without the mark of child protective packaging or imports, displays or stores such products for the purpose of selling them, in violation of Article 34 ;
A person who uses electrical appliances subject to safety inspection without a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-5 (3).
Article 50 (Joint Penalty Provisions)
Article 51 (Administrative Fines)
Any of the following persons shall be subject to an administrative fine of not more than 10 million won: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who rejects, interferes with, or evades a periodic inspection under Article 7 (1);

A person who sells or rents consumer products subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark or imports, displays or stores such products for the purpose of selling or renting them, in violation of Article 10 (1);

A person who sells or rents consumer products subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark or imports, displays or stores such products for the purpose of selling or renting them, in violation of Article 19 (1);
A person who files a report (or a report on change) on the use of child protective packaging under Article 32 (2);
A person who fails to take necessary measures to ensure liability for compensation for loss, in violation of Article 34-9 (2);
A person who fails to give notice concerning buying services, in violation of Article 36 (1);
A person who fails to put a label of parallel importation or fails to give notice, in violation of Article 38 (1);
A person who fails to submit a report under Article 41 (1) or submits a false report;
A person who rejects, interferes with or evades an inspection or inquiry under Article 41 (1).
Any of the following persons shall be subject to an administrative fine of not more than five million won: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022>
A person who fails to conduct an internal inspection under Article 7 (2) or prepares and retains a false record of an internal inspection;
A person who fails to put the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 9 (1);
A person who fails to publish information about safety certification, in violation of Article 9 (4);

A person who acts as a sales broker, a buying agent or an import agent for consumer products subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 10 (2) (excluding cases where a person acts as a buying agent pursuant to Article 35 (1));
A person who uses a consumer product subject to safety certification without the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 10 (3);
A person who fails to keep documents demonstrating that the relevant products conform to safety standards, in violation of Article 15 (5), or who keeps false documents regarding such products;
A person who fails to put the safety certification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 18 (1);
A person who fails to publish information on safety verification, in violation of Article 18 (4);

A person who acts as a sales broker, a buying agent or an import agent for consumer products subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 19 (2) (excluding persons who act as a buying agent under subparagraph 3 of Article 35) ;
A person who uses a consumer product subject to safety verification without the safety verification mark or a similar mark, in violation of Article 19 (3);

A person who produces or imports electrical appliances subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without filing a report or a report on change in the supplier's declaration of conformity, in violation of Article 23 (2);
A person who fails to keep documents demonstrating that the relevant products conform to safety standards, in violation of Article 23 (5), or who keeps false documents regarding such products;
A person who fails to put the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 25 (1);
A person who fails to publish information about the supplier's declaration of conformity, in violation of Article 25 (4);

A person who sells or rents consumer products subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, or imports, displays or stores such consumer products for the purpose of selling or renting them, in violation of Article 26 (1);

A person who acts as a sales broker or an import agent for consumer products subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (2);

A person who uses a consumer product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity without the mark of the supplier's declaration of conformity or a similar mark, in violation of Article 26 (3);
A person who fails to put the mark of a consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards, in violation of Article 29 (1);

A person who sells any consumer product subject to compliance with safety standards without any mark, or imports, displays or stores such product for the purpose of selling the product, in violation of Article 30 ;
A person who fails to put the mark of child protective packaging, in violation of Article 33 (1);
A person who fails to keep documents demonstrating that the relevant products conform to the safety standards or keeps false documents, in violation of Article 34-3 (3);
A person who fails to put a safety inspection mark, etc., in violation of Article 34-4 (1);
A person who fails to post information related to safety inspection, in violation of Article 34-4 (4);
A person who puts a label of parallel importation on any product not imported through parallel importation in violation of Article 38 (2);
A person who sells a product subject to safety control to a child who has not attained the minimum age eligible for the use of the product subject to safety control, in violation of Article 39 .
Administrative fines under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy or each Mayor/ Do Governor, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
Acts, including reports, done to an administrative agency under the previous provisions as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed done under relevant provisions of this Act.

Measures, procedures and other actions taken by an administrative agency, including revocation, prohibition of the use of a mark or label, orders for improvement, proceedings and public announcements, under the previous provisions as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed taken or executed under relevant provisions of this Act.

The Product Safety Deliberation Committee existing as at the time this Act enters into force pursuant to the previous provisions of Article 3 shall be deemed the Product Safety Deliberation Committee established pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 3 .

The persons in service as the chairperson or members of the Product Safety Deliberation Committee as at the time this Act enters into force since they were elected, appointed or commissioned under the previous provisions of Article 3 (2) shall be deemed elected, appointed or commissioned as the chairperson or members of the Product Safety Deliberation Committee under the amended provisions of Article 3 (2); and the term of office of the commissioned members shall expire at the end of the term of office specified in the previous provisions of Article 3 (3).

The electrical appliances and consumer products the safety of which were certified under the previous provisions of Article 5 (1) as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed to have their safety certified under the amended provisions of Article 5 (1).
The safety certifications amended under the previous provisions of Article 5 (2) as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed amended under the previous provisions of Article 5 (2).

The electrical appliances and industrial products exempted from safety certification under the previous provisions of Article 6 as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed to be exempted from safety certification under the amended provisions of Article 6 .
The periodic inspections conducted under the previous provisions of Article 7 (1) before this Act enters into force shall be deemed conducted under the amended provisions of Article 7 (1).
The internal inspections conducted under the previous provisions of Article 7 (2) before this Act enters into force shall be deemed conducted under the amended provisions of Article 7 (2).

If a safety verification report was filed for a product subject to safety verification in accordance with the previous provisions of Article 15 (1) before this Act enters into force, the safety verification report shall be deemed filed for the same product in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 15 (1).

If a revised report was filed with respect to a safety verification report in accordance with the previous provisions of Article 15 (2) before this Act enters into force, the revised report shall be deemed filed in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 15 (2).

If any electrical appliance or consumer product subject to safety verification was exempted from the reporting of safety verification under the previous provisions of Article 16 before his Act enters into force, such product shall be deemed to be exempted from the reporting of safety verification under the amended provisions of Article 16 .

If a supplier declared the conformity of any consumer product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity in accordance with the previous provisions of Article 23 (1) before this Act enters into force, the conformity of such product shall be deemed declared by the supplier in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 23 (1).

If a report on the supplier's declaration of conformity was filed for an electrical appliance in accordance with the previous provisions of Article 23 (2) before this Act enters into force, it shall be deemed that the report on the supplier's declaration of conformity has been filed for the same electrical appliance in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 23 (2).

If a product subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity was exempted from the supplier's declaration of conformity or from the reporting of the supplier's declaration of conformity under the previous provisions of Article 24 before this Act enters into force, such product shall be deemed to be exempted from the supplier's declaration of conformity or from the reporting of the supplier's declaration of conformity under the amended provisions of Article 24 .

If the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy confirmed that a product was exempted from the use of child protective packaging under the previous proviso to Article 28 (1) before this Act enters into force, such product shall be deemed to be exempted from the use of child protective packaging under the amended proviso to Article 32 (1).

If a report or a revised report was filed for any consumer product subject to child protective packaging under the previous provisions of Article 28 (2) before this Act enters into force, such report or revised report shall be deemed filed under the amended provisions of Article 32 (2).
rawText: ELECTRICAL APPLIANCES AND CONSUMER PRODUCTS SAFETY CONTROL ACT Amended by Act No. 19005, Oct. 18, 2022 Wholly Amended by Act No. 15338, Dec. 30, 2017 Amended by Act No. 19005, Oct. 18, 2022 CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS 법령보기 화면 Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to protect the lives, health and property of people and promote the benefits and safety of consumers by providing for matters related to safety control of electrical appliances and consumer products. 법령보기 화면 Article 2 (Definitions) The terms used in this Act are defined as follows: <Amended on Oct. 18, 2022> 1. The term "electrical appliances" means industrially manufactured products that can be used by connecting to an alternating or direct current power source and components or parts of such products; 2. The term "consumer products" means industrially manufactured products for consumer use without additional processing (excluding simple assembling) and components or parts of such products (excluding electrical appliances); 3. The term "production" means manufacturing, assembling, or processing electrical appliances or consumer products for the purpose of distributing or renting them; 4. The term "safety control of products" means activities of controlling the production, importation, distribution, etc. of products to prevent hazards to the lives or health of consumers or damage to property or to the natural environment, which might arise in the course of handling and using products; 5. The term "safety certification" means certifying the safety of a product after testing the product and assessing the factory of the product; 6. The term "safety verification" means verifying whether a product conforms to safety standards as a result of a safety verification test conducted by a testing lab for safety verification; 7. The term "supplier's declaration of conformity" means a supplier's declaration that any of its products conforms to safety standards by voluntarily testing the product or by requesting a third party to test the product; 8. The term "product testing" means testing a product to verify the safety of the product itself; 9. The term "factory assessment" means assessing manufacturing facilities, testing facilities, technical capacity and manufacturing systems necessary for manufacturing products; 9-2. The term "safety inspection" means verifying whether safety standards are satisfied through an inspection conducted by an institution designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy pursuant to Article 34-2 (1) (hereinafter referred to as "safety inspection institution"); 10. The term "products subject to safety certification" means the following electrical appliances and consumer products: (a) Electrical appliances subject to safety certification: Electrical appliances specified by and approved under Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through safety certification, where it is highly anticipated that the structure, usage, etc. of such electrical appliances will cause hazards, such as fire and electrocution; (b) Consumer products subject to safety certification: Consumer products specified by and approved under Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through safety certification, where it is highly anticipated that the structure, materials, usage, etc. of such consumer products will harm the lives and bodies of consumers or cause damage to property or to the natural environment; 11. The term "products subject to safety verification" means the following electrical appliances and consumer products: (a) Electrical appliances subject to safety verification: Electrical appliances specified and approved by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through product testing by an institution designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, where the structure, usage, etc. of such electrical appliances are likely to cause hazards, such as fire and electrocution; (b) Consumer products subject to safety verification: Consumer products specified and approved by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through product testing by an institution designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, where the structure, materials, usage, etc. of such consumer products are likely to harm the lives and bodies of consumers or cause damage to property or to the natural environment; 12. The term "products subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity" means the following electrical appliances and consumer products: (a) Electrical appliances subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity: Electrical appliances specified and approved by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through product testing directly by a manufacturer or an importer or by a third party at the request of a manufacturer or an importer, where the structure, usage, etc. of such electrical appliances are likely to cause hazards, such as fire and electrocution; (b) Consumer products subject to the supplier's declaration of conformity: Consumer products specified and approved by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through product testing directly by a manufacturer or an importer or by a third party at the request of a manufacturer or an importer, where such consumer products are likely to cause an accident or harm consumers, while consumers handle, use, carry or manage them otherwise or where it is difficult for consumers to identify the difference in ingredients, performance, specifications, etc.; 13. The term "consumer products subject to compliance with safety standards" means consumer products specified and approved by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those from which hazards can be prevented through the compliance with safety standards by the manufacturer or importer, where it is difficult for consumers to identify the difference in ingredients, performance, specifications, etc., although such consumer products are less likely to cause an accident or harm consumers, while consumers handle, use, carry or manage them otherwise; 14. The term "child protective packaging" means packages and containers designed and devised to make it difficult for children aged under five years to take out contents therein within a certain period of time, although it is not difficult for adults to open them; 15. The term "consumer products subject to child protective packaging" means consumer products specified by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as those subject to child protective packaging, from among consumer products that are likely to cause hazards, such as poisoning, if a consumer drinks or inhales them; 15-2. The term "electrical appliances subject to safety inspection" means re-used electrical appliances (referring to those manufactured for the purpose of reusing used electrical appliances) where their structure, usage, etc. are likely to cause hazards, such as fire and electrocution, and which are prescribed by Ministerial Decree of Trade, Industry and Energy as they are deemed to prevent such hazards through a safety inspection conducted by a safety inspection institution; 16. The term "buying services" means services provided by a person acting as an agent for a domestic consumer, upon the consumer's request for personal use, in the process of placing an order for a product sold overseas and paying the price for the product so as to make an arrangement with an overseas seller to dispatch the product directly to the consumer; 17.
